about: Line edits that turn the as-run analysis scripts into the ported copies under replicate/analysis/. Only path constants, hard-coded candidate coordinates and the candidate's protein-change labels are replaced; three comment-only edits label public coordinates as public annotation. Each edit replaces exactly one line, so the ported file has the same number of lines as the original and every other line is byte-identical. The original text of an edited line is NOT stored here (some contain the organiser sample ID or candidate coordinates); its keyed hash (HMAC-SHA256; the authors keep the key with the originals) is stored in replicate/analysis/PORTING.json instead, because a plain sha256 of a short line can be reversed by trying candidates. Origins: 'candidates:' = copy of the as-run script kept privately by the authors (the repo as-run copy is named in repo_copy when it exists); 'recovered:' = script recovered from the session transcript that ran it. The as-run copies in this repository are under as_run/; where one of them named a local user name, disk identifier or session folder, that token is replaced by '[redacted]' in the public copy (column 'repo_copy_redactions' in PORTING.json); the audit then compares every other line.
